notes: ADR 0013 restore drill: latest encrypted pg_dump decrypted with the offline recipient key, restored into a throwaway postgres:16-alpine, row counts compared with the counts taken at backup time (restored >= counted), and a sample of encrypted objects decrypted and compared by SHA-256 with the live objects. Environment: local; partial unless run on the trial host. Finding: pg_restore fails on outbox_events (0 of 20 rows) because the CHECK function outbox_payload_is_whitelisted calls outbox_payload_allowed_keys unqualified, and pg_dump restores with an empty search_path; the notifications foreign key then fails too. Reproduced in isolation and fixed there by schema-qualifying the call (public.outbox_payload_allowed_keys) or SET search_path on the function; with the fix applied to the live database the same drill passed (20 tables, 4 of 4 objects). The migration belongs to the data agent (apps/api/src/db).
